snapshot_identity.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, sorted object keys, compact separators, Unicode preserved; membership facts sorted by sector_type, sector_id, security_id, source_security_key

field_rules.membership_asof_date: Required for PIT_OBSERVED. May be null only in diagnostic records with an explicit effective-date-unknown quality reason.
field_rules.provider_available_at: Required for PIT_OBSERVED and must be no later than the snapshot cutoff.
field_rules.observed_at: Time the exact source bytes were observed by the project.
field_rules.ingested_at: Time those bytes entered the V4-owned snapshot workflow.
field_rules.system_available_at: Earliest time the fact could be consumed by a V4 publication; must be no earlier than observed_at and no later than cutoff for a selected fact.
field_rules.source_file_digests: Map of source-relative file identifiers to lowercase SHA-256 values; files under TDX source roots are read-only inputs.

revision_policy.correction: Create a new source_revision_id and snapshot revision; supersedes_revision_id points to the previous revision.
revision_policy.revision_forks: REJECT; one revision may have at most one direct successor.
revision_policy.same_day_revisions: Allowed only as a single non-forking supersession chain.
revision_policy.unknown_security_identity: Retain diagnostic source key and UNKNOWN quality; block formal snapshot and never silently drop the row.
revision_policy.temporal_selection: Only source revisions with system_available_at <= requested cutoff may be selected.

parent_industry_policy.derivation: Set union of accepted child industry memberships under a versioned parent-child map; de-duplicate parent/security pairs and retain all child provenance.

quality_propagation.unknown_security_id: UNKNOWN; fail closed for formal materialization
quality_propagation.base_seed_dependent_fields: UNKNOWN / DEGRADED_BY_UPSTREAM_BASE_SEED_SIGNAL until the accepted prior-RPS bootstrap audit closes; never coerce to zero.
